# aoss_version (Data Source)

Provides information about the software version reported by the switch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aoss_version" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `boot_image` (String) The name of the boot image in use (Primary or Secondary).
- `build_date` (String) The build date stamp of the running software image.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rom_version` (String) The boot ROM version reported by the switch.
- `version` (String) The software version string reported by the switch.
